name: Ace Inside Zone Right
purpose: With four receivers pulling defenders wide there are fewer bodies left in the middle. Every lineman steps to the playside, and the back runs to the first crease that opens.

X.rule: Block the defender covering you. Stay between him and the middle of the field.

LT.rule: Step playside and block whoever shows in your gap. If nobody does, climb to the linebacker.

LG.rule: Step playside and block whoever shows in your gap.

C.rule: Step playside and block whoever shows. If nobody is there, help the guard and climb.

RG.rule: Step playside and block whoever shows in your gap.

RT.rule: Step playside and block whoever shows in your gap.

TE.rule: Step playside and block the man over you. Turn him however he wants to go.

W.rule: Block the defender covering you and stay on him.

Z.rule: Block the defender covering you and stay on him.

QB.rule: Open playside, hand the ball to the back at three yards, then carry out a fake to the backside.

TB.rule: Aim at the playside guard's outside hip. Take the ball, run to the first crease that opens, and go north through it. One cut only.

coaching_points: Everybody steps the same direction. That is the whole rule — do not teach eleven different assignments.
One cut and go. A back who dances behind this line loses yards.
Count how many defenders are in the box before you call it. If it is six or fewer, run it again.
